AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agri- business Accounts? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Agri- business Accounts.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agri- business Accounts.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agri- business Accounts.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agri- business Accounts.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Nutrition.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Nutrition.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Nutrition.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Nutrition.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Cropping? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Cropping.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Cropping.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Cropping.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Cropping.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Disease Control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Disease Control.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Disease Control.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Disease Control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Disease Control.

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agricultural Biotechnology? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agricultural Biotechnology.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Biotechnology.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Agricultural Biotechnology.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agricultural Biotechnology.

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Breeding? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Breeding.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Breeding.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Breeding.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Breeding.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

13. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Disease control? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Disease control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Disease control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Disease control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Disease control.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Erosion Control? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Erosion Control.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Erosion Control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Erosion Control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Erosion Control.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Powered Agricultural Implements? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Powered Agricultural Implements.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Powered Agricultural Implements.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Powered Agricultural Implements.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Powered Agricultural Implements.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Urban and peri-urban Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Powered Agricultural Implements and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Agricultural Biotechnology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Agri- business Accounts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Business and Career Opportunities in Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
